$comment: Built-in agent skills, vendored from public repositories at a pinned commit. Edit `ref` (or run `npm run skills:sync -- --update <slug>`), then `npm run skills:sync` and open a pull request with the diff. Never fetched at agent runtime. `usage` replaces upstream instructions that assume a shell (TechTeam agents can't run commands).

skills.usage: Upstream tells agents to run `npx modern-web-guidance search/retrieve`; you can't run commands, so use search_skill instead of `search` (a 2–5 word query naming one web capability or UI pattern, e.g. "light dismiss dialog", "responsive data table", no framework names) and read_skill with the guide's path instead of `retrieve` (e.g. guides/css/css-layout.md). Search before writing or reviewing HTML, CSS or client-side JavaScript; follow the guide's fallbacks for features that aren't Baseline widely available. Security reviews: search the security and sanitization topics (e.g. "sanitize html", "passkey sign in"). Skip the upstream steps about legacy-scan, permissions and disclosure sections.
Only for Chrome extension projects (Manifest V3). Read SKILL.md first with read_skill, then the references/ file for the API you touch (search_skill finds it, e.g. "side panel", "message passing").
